writes.classification: Separately applied additive type:architecture; repository labels verified first.

guards: Exact repository and issue ID, URL and number; original title; complete label objects; state, body, assignees, milestone, updated_at match immediately before writing.
Persist an intent before each title-only write; reread and retain per-operation result afterward.
Non-atomic API compare then write: a concurrent edit in the gap remains possible; reread detects observed mismatch, not all intermediate races.
recovery: On interruption, reread saved issue identity and current fields; if recorded desired title and original preserved fields match, skip writing and record recovered success.
If original title and preserved fields still match, revalidate/review the remaining plan before retry; all other drift stops the issue.

Rollback only the title after a fresh comparison against exact recorded after-state including updated_at and full labels; restore recorded old title only. Never overwrite newer edits or automatically remove labels.
Verify repeat native preview yields three unchanged rows; no duplicate write for an already applied title.
limitations: Manual scoped procedure, not a reusable apply/recovery engine.
Candidate/observe title source remains unchanged; no automatic policy promotion.
No fleet sweep or event enforcement.
